info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Refinances-v3-spec
info.description: This API provides access to detailed information about mortgage loan refinancing options. Users can retrieve a list of available refinance loans, which can assist homeowners in finding suitable refinancing solutions tailored to their needs. Typical consumers of this API include mortgage brokers, financial advisors, and home loan portfolio managers seeking to enhance their offerings. The endpoint serves as a valuable resource for analyzing and comparing different refinancing products in the market.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch various refinancing options available for loans. It provides details about interest rates, terms, and eligibility criteria to help users make informed decisions about refinancing their loans.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a refinance operation on loans. This body must adhere to the defined schema and include all necessary parameters for a successful refinance transaction.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for refinancing loan operations.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_200.title: Refinance Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the refinance operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the refinance operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result from the refinance operation.

state.description: The current state of the refinance operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refinance operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the refinance operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the refinance operation.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for the refinance operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema provides details about the audit related to the refinance operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
